# Build with MiroTalk

Add browser-based video communication to a website, application, support workflow, or SaaS product using the integration surface supported by your selected MiroTalk product.

## Choose an integration path

| Goal | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Embed a meeting or call | [Quick iframe integration](../utility/quick-custom-integration.md) |
| Create rooms from an application | [REST API documentation](#rest-apis) |
| Send users directly into a room | [Direct-join documentation](#direct-join) |
| React to meeting or call events | [Webhook documentation](#webhooks) |
| Add subscriptions to MiroTalk WEB | [Stripe SaaS billing](../mirotalk-web/stripe.md) |

## REST APIs

- [MiroTalk SFU REST API](../mirotalk-sfu/api.md)
- [MiroTalk P2P REST API](../mirotalk-p2p/api.md)
- [MiroTalk C2C REST API](../mirotalk-c2c/api.md)
- [MiroTalk BRO REST API](../mirotalk-bro/api.md)
- [MiroTalk CME REST API](../mirotalk-cme/api.md)
- [MiroTalk WEB REST API](../mirotalk-web/api.md)

API behavior differs by product. Use the guide and deployed Swagger documentation for the product you are integrating; do not assume endpoints are interchangeable.
